'''The Stilt Monster''' was a being who ran into [[Rycar Ryjerd/Legends|Rycar Ryjerd]], while walking through the streets of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="Holiday Special" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Stilt Monster first appeared in a deleted scene from [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The same scene was later reused in [[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]. The Stilt Monster is played by [[Peter Barbour]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|41|The Evolution of Star Wars: Exploring the Lost Cut|The Evolution of ''Star Wars'': Exploring the Lost Cut}}</ref>
